experiment.name: Prospective Structured-Extraction Requalification and Generalization Test

research_question: Under the byte-bound G-ROUTE4 extraction system prompt, renderer, normalization and operational validator, can a larger family-stratified qualification test identify R2/R3 model-tier cells that retain safe and useful behavior on separately authored validation fixtures without false-clean extraction errors?
causal_limit: The experiment tests whether stronger prospective sampling and coverage would have exposed observed failure classes. It does not separately identify prompt wording, model weights, provider internals or stochastic sampling as the cause.

risk_definitions.R2: costly but reversible money, order, booking or workplace administration consequence
risk_definitions.R3: security, privacy, compliance or access consequence with possible data exposure or access grant

hypotheses.statement: At least one G-ROUTE4-qualified extraction cell will fail the larger Phase A gate.
Date/time and numeric/threshold families will produce more errors than entity/binding families.
Some wrong answers will recur across both Phase A repeats.
Qualification need not be monotonic with parameter count.
A Phase A-qualified cell must independently pass Phase B.

A.purpose: prospective requalification under the byte-bound baseline

operation_definition_contract.operation_order: stable topological order by dependencies, then unsigned UTF-8 byte order of target field
operation_definition_contract.operand_list_serialization: two operands use 'A and B'; three or more use comma-space separators and 'and ' before the final operand; operand order is metadata order and immutable

catalog.template: {target} is the number of entries in {collection}.
{target} is the elapsed minutes from {start} to {end}.
{target} is true when {left} is greater than {right}.
{target} is true when {left} is greater than or equal to {right}.
{target} is true when {left} is less than {right}.
{target} is true when {left} is less than or equal to {right}.
{target} is true when {left} is equal to {right}.
{target} is {source_field} for the entity whose {selector_field} equals {selector_value}.

unit_conversion_catalog.template: {target} is {source} multiplied by 60, expressed in minutes.
{target} is {source} divided by 60, expressed in hours.
{target} is {source} multiplied by 1000, expressed in grams.
{target} is {source} divided by 1000, expressed in kilograms.
{target} is {source} multiplied by 100, expressed in cents.
{target} is {source} divided by 100, expressed in dollars.

operation_definition_contract.historical_absence_sentence: Use 'not_provided' when the text says a value has not been provided.
operation_definition_contract.absence_sentence_condition: present exactly once if and only if a schema field has type provided|not_provided

unknown_sentinel_available.derivation: true iff any schema value is exactly provided|not_provided

entity_disambiguation_required.derivation: true iff at least two named entity records expose the selected source field and ENTITY_FIELD_BIND selects one by a distinct selector field/value

entity_selector_role.derivation: NONE unless ENTITY_FIELD_BIND is present; otherwise copied from the frozen schema role of selector_field

source_fact_sequence.derivation: one entry per source sentence in byte order; entity_index is -1 when no entity applies

direct_copy_only.derivation: true iff every operation node is EXACT_COPY

requirements.additional_distribution: at least one CALENDAR_DAY_OFFSET and at least one CLOCK_MINUTE_OFFSET or ELAPSED_MINUTES

historical_model_facing_contract.instruction: Use 'not_provided' when the text says a value has not been provided.

primary_outcome_precedence.includes: all non-empty prose-only responses; no refusal-intent inference

ambiguity_contract.classifier_exhaustiveness_invariant: after priorities 1-6, an exact schema-valid object has a boolean sentinel-equality result and a boolean supported-fields-equality result; priorities 7-9 therefore cover all remaining outputs

semantic_rules.integer: JSON lexical integer only; 5 passes; 5.0 and 5e0 fail; -0 equals 0
semantic_rules.number: exact decimal value; 5, 5.0, 5.00 and 5e0 are equivalent; no binary-float tolerance
semantic_rules.units: only operation-definition unit_conversion_catalog conversions are permitted; unit-bearing strings exact; omission fails
semantic_rules.string_entity: exact Unicode scalar sequence, case, whitespace and punctuation; no normalization, trimming, aliases, abbreviation or case folding
semantic_rules.label_removal_rule: exact leading listed label plus one following space only
semantic_rules.json_object: key order and insignificant JSON whitespace ignored recursively; duplicates, extras, omissions and nulls invalid
semantic_rules.arrays_and_nested_values: prohibited in scored baseline extraction schemas
semantic_rules.date: exact zero-padded YYYY-MM-DD, valid proleptic Gregorian date, start date day zero for plus-N-days
semantic_rules.time: exact zero-padded 24-hour HH:MM with forward elapsed-time interpretation and explicit midnight rollover

exact_value_contract.operational_semantic_disagreement_rule: operationally accepted plus semantically invalid is false-clean

review_steps: author creates fixture, derivation, gold, rationale, fingerprint and reserve mapping
Reviewer A solves without seeing proposed gold
Reviewer B audits arithmetic, calendar semantics, bindings, family assignment and exact-value compliance
operator-approved adjudicator resolves preserved disagreements before provider contact

contamination_contract.authored_model_facing_character_set: printable ASCII plus CR, LF and TAB; all other code points are prohibited before fixture freeze
contamination_contract.canonical_schema_serialization: schema keys sorted by unsigned UTF-8 bytes; each line is field=type; LF separators; no terminal LF

boilerplate_exclusion.method: construct similarity payload from input.text and canonical schema only; do not subtract substrings after concatenation

excluded_request_spans.span: entire UTF-8 value, including opening, operation sentences, historical absence sentence and frozen common suffix
exact UTF-8 bytes INPUT followed by LF

text_normalization.whitespace: every maximal Unicode whitespace run becomes one ASCII space and leading/trailing spaces are removed
text_normalization.punctuation: punctuation is not rewritten; the tokenizer skips unmatched punctuation so signs, decimal points and exponent signs remain available to the numeric alternative
text_normalization.numbers: the tokenizer receives normalized text before punctuation skipping and preserves each complete signed decimal or exponent match
text_normalization.entities: no anonymization or special replacement; normalized like other alphabetic tokens

tokenizer.match_mode: left-to-right non-overlapping finditer over normalized text

ngram.construction: ordered contiguous token tuples at offsets 0 through token_count-5, deduplicated as a set

fingerprint.canonical_serialization: UTF-8 JSON array in listed component order; ensure_ascii=false; separators comma/colon; no whitespace or terminal newline

components.structure: array of operation nodes; each node is [operation_id, operand_kind_array, dependency_index_array]; field names and literal values are excluded
components.derivation: perform a stable topological sort of frozen operation nodes, selecting the unsigned UTF-8-lowest target field among ready nodes; operand kinds follow the catalog placeholder order with target omitted; dependency indices are sorted unique zero-based indices into the resulting node array

components.structure: array containing one [schema_type, role] pair per output field with field names removed; duplicate pairs are retained
components.derivation: derive role from the operation producing the field, or source_copy for an untransformed field, then sort compact pair serializations by unsigned UTF-8 bytes

NONE when entity_record_count is zero; SINGLE_ENTITY when it is one; MULTI_ENTITY_NO_DISAMBIGUATION when greater than one and entity_disambiguation_required is false; otherwise map entity_selector_role IDENTIFIER, ATTRIBUTE or EVENT_ROLE to the matching MULTI_ENTITY_SELECT value
NONE unless terminal_operation is GT, GTE, LT, LTE or EQ; otherwise evaluate exact left and right operands under gold semantics and emit BELOW, EQUAL or ABOVE from left compared with right

NONE without a temporal operation; CLOCK_MINUTE_OFFSET or ELAPSED_MINUTES emits MIDNIGHT_ROLLOVER iff the forward result crosses midnight, otherwise SAME_DAY_FORWARD; CALENDAR_DAY_OFFSET emits LEAP_DAY_BOUNDARY iff its inclusive traversed dates contain February 29, else YEAR_BOUNDARY iff source and result years differ, else MONTH_BOUNDARY iff months differ, else DATE_WITHIN_MONTH

from source_fact_sequence first-match: EXPLICIT_PARTIAL_ABSENCE if any EXPLICIT_ABSENCE; INTERLEAVED_MULTI_ENTITY if target/support entries for at least two entities alternate after projecting out distractors; DISTRACTOR_BEFORE_TARGET if at least one DISTRACTOR exists and every DISTRACTOR index precedes every TARGET/SUPPORT index; DISTRACTOR_AFTER_TARGET if at least one DISTRACTOR exists and every DISTRACTOR index follows every TARGET/SUPPORT index; TARGET_BEFORE_SUPPORTING_FACTS if at least one SUPPORT exists and the first TARGET precedes every SUPPORT; otherwise CONTIGUOUS_SINGLE_ENTITY, which requires at most one entity and contiguous TARGET/SUPPORT indices; failure of the final requirement is an authoring error

pairwise_scope: every G-ROUTE4 extraction fixture versus every G-EXTRACT1 scored or reserve fixture
every scored fixture versus every reserve

exact_fingerprint_collision_rules.within_same_phase_round_family: allowed at most twice only when Jaccard is below 0.12 and all values/entities differ

contamination_contract.near_replay_rule: prohibited for every pair when at least five of six fingerprint components match and token 5-gram Jaccard is at least 0.12

confidence_contract.interpretation: benchmark decision statistics under the frozen authored-fixture design, not population-generalization estimates

correlated_false_clean.reason: Phase B has no repeat pairs

cell_state_machine.phase_b_selector: sorted exact set of A_QUALIFIED_FOR_B cell IDs
transitions: precontact blocker exists before provider contact
complete denominator and all A gates pass
complete denominator and any A gate fails
machine-built conditional schedule contains exact cell
complete denominator and all B gates pass
complete denominator and any B gate fails

classification_rules: a timeout, provider error or missing response is INCOMPLETE only with an append-only failure receipt bound to the scheduled call
an unaccounted scheduled call without such a receipt is INVALID
an interruption is INCOMPLETE only when the checkpoint and journal prefix verify
an unverifiable or corrupt checkpoint or journal is INVALID
a semantic or malformed-output gate failure is not an integrity event

deterministic_test_vectors.facts: valid terminal Phase A plus zero B entrants
one or more B entrants, terminal B, zero final qualifiers
terminal B with at least one final qualifier and at least one B failure
terminal B with all one-or-more entrants finally qualified
any invalid event after partial execution
complete Phase A; every cell fails malformed gate; no integrity event

baseline_binding.system_text: Return one JSON object matching the schema supplied in the fixture. Add no fields. Use only explicit facts; represent an explicitly unstated value with the schema's unknown value.
baseline_binding.structured_extraction_assembled_template: {SUBJECT}. Copy names and identifiers exactly as written in the text, keeping their capitalization and leaving out leading articles and labels such as 'the', 'Order' or 'Vendor'. Use JSON numbers for number fields, whole numbers written without a decimal point for integer fields (5, not 5.0), true or false for boolean fields, strings written as YYYY-MM-DD or HH:MM for fields of those types, and exactly one of the listed values for fields whose type lists values separated by |. Keep the reply compact: output beyond about 350 tokens is cut off.
permitted_model_facing_variable_slots: catalog-rendered operation placeholder identifiers or literals

efficiency.basis: preserved G-ROUTE4 observed means: 7.6 seconds small, 13.0 seconds mid, 51.2 seconds large

integration.candidate_overlay_scope: finally qualified structured-extraction R2/R3 cells only

validation_claim_scope.validator_claim: deterministic structural and cross-representation consistency only
